posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Step one: get your envelope of goodies from your fellow Global Friends!

![|700x420](upload://znZE41cSlUetmp7S7BVFH673yU3.jpeg)

Step two: play a game against the enclosed Mad Bomber Blade!

Step three: take a picture of you and your friends playing and post it here!

Step four: follow the instructions, fill out the Battle Report, and put it all back in the envelope! (Be sure to put the correct stamp on the back of the envelope, depending on whether you won or lost.)

Step five: tape the envelope closed! (DON'T SEAL THE ENVELOPE WITH THE LICKABLE GLUE! If you do, it won't be easily opened by the next person. The metal closing thing plus a layer of tape is plenty. And the tape is easy to cut off.)

Step six: make sure you have plenty of postage. It'll cost more than the stamp will cover, but not a ton more. You'll have to talk to your friendly local USPS people to make sure you have sufficient postage.

Step seven: mail it to the next person on the list!

Let's send the Mad Baron around the world!
